note: Lineage record for the 15 batch-B2 California family-law research tasks (research-001..015), all track frozen_evidence, data_class public, expected_tools []. Every material criterion is tied to a proposition whose authoritative_excerpt is a verbatim substring of an official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov Family Code excerpt already in sources.jsonl; the source-entailment guard in datasetTools/authorTasks.ts enforced this at authoring time. No case law, secondary source, or model memory was used, and no citation or statutory text was paraphrased into a proposition excerpt. Fact patterns in the prompts are synthetic hypotheticals written for the eval; they contain no client information.

new_source_records.harvest_method: Raw curl GET of the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov codes_displaySection.xhtml page for each Family Code section, tag-stripped and whitespace-normalized with the same normalizer datasetTools/verifySources.ts applies, then sliced to a contiguous subdivision window and ingested via datasetTools/ingestSources.ts. Each new record is a second (or, for FAM 4055, a second and third) excerpt window of a leginfo page already represented in the registry, except STAT-CAL-FAM-CODE-721 which is a new section.

effective_date_layering: Five tasks carry an explicit effective/operative-date criterion backed by verbatim statutory date text: FAM 4055(d) and FAM 4058(d) (operative September 1, 2024), FAM 3044(i) (effective January 1, 2026), FAM 1615(c)(2)(B) (agreements executed on or after January 1, 2020), and FAM 852(e) (no application to transmutations made before January 1, 1985). No WRONG_JURISDICTION assertion was written for this batch: no registry excerpt supports a jurisdiction trap for these questions, and an ungrounded one would violate the entailment rule.
